text:
**Verdict: False as commonly understood.** NASA says the Great Wall is generally **not visible to the naked eye from low Earth orbit** because it is narrow and blends into the surrounding landscape. It cannot be seen with the naked eye from the Moon.

**Nuance:** Some astronauts have reported spotting sections from low orbit under exceptional lighting and viewing conditions. Thus, “never visible from anywhere in space” would also be too absolute. Zoom-camera or satellite photographs do not establish naked-eye visibility.

**Source:** NASA, *“China’s Wall Less Great in View from Space”* (2005).
